explication: Go2TV casts local or remote media to DLNA/UPnP and Chromecast receivers. The main workflow is to choose media and a discovered device, prepare a stream (including optional transcoding or subtitles), then control playback. The GUI, CLI, and server-mode Web UI are distinct entry points; playback adapters bridge shared orchestration to device protocols. The README documents additional playlist, seek, RTMP, and desktop-casting capabilities. Connections reflect excerpts and documented behavior; unsampled implementation details are not inferred.
